title: Delete Part shows only on an existing part, to a user with Delete
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • A second user, {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL User B), has the custom role {Role-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL NODEL ROLE), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit' on, Delete off and See Financial Data on, and access to {Location-A}.
  • {User-B} is signed in at {Location-A} in a second browser (or a private window).
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-DELVIS-01) is stocked at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. As the Admin, go to Parts → Inventory and click New Inventory Part.
  2. Click Cancel.
  3. As the Admin, type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  4. Click the {Part-A} row.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. As {User-B}, type {Part-A} in the Inventory search.
  7. Click the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the New Inventory Part footer shows only Cancel and Save; there is no Delete Part.
  • Step 4: the Edit Inventory Part footer shows Delete Part at the left.
  • Step 7: {User-B} sees no Delete Part button.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-R10, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.1 (New Inventory Part opens), board 2.1 (The part as it stands), 13 Oct copy.
